title: Brasso
description: Brasso worked in the salvage yards as a Grappler in the self-made tradition of Ferrix. He worked long days dismantling starships and any other technological detritus that made its way there. He was a good friend of Maarva Andor and her son, Cassian, going so far as to lie on Cassian's behalf to get him out of trouble, and smash Imperials when it really came down to it.
